title: Cofinal diagonal factorization of the finite scalar pullback square
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\iota:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes. Let $P$ be any unbounded complex of completed $E$-coefficient module sheaves [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. Write $\mathcal O_F$ for the valuation ring of $F$, $\varpi_F$ for its chosen uniformizer and $A_{F,r}=\mathcal O_F/(\varpi_F^r)$ for $r\ge1$, with the corresponding constant finite sheaves and completed inverse limit $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,-}$. Put $C_n=\operatorname{Res}_n f^*(P\otimes A_{E,n+1})\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,X}$ and $D_n=\operatorname{Res}_n f^*((P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,Y})\otimes A_{L,n+1})$, with the strict transitions of that node and ordinary scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Suppose $\alpha:C_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ is a strict tower map whose degree $i$ component, on every $V\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and section $x\in P^i(V)$, sends $1\otimes f^*(1\otimes x)$ to $f^*(1\otimes(1\otimes x))$. Write C and D for the displayed strict source and target towers. For every n there are m≥n and a chain map b:D_m→C_n such that alpha_m followed by b is the source transition C_m→C_n, and b followed by alpha_n is the target transition D_m→D_n. This is a statement about ordinary quotient and pullback maps, before forming cones, homotopies, products or limits; flatness of P is not assumed.

proof.text: Use the proved DVR ramification calculation in RamifiedPullbackTowerIdentification to obtain a positive exponent e, the cofinal index r(n)=e(n+1)-1, and the induced quotient maps. Apply the existing ramified coefficient comparison on X and Y, then the finite pullback comparison. Uniqueness of the completed scalar map identifies their completed maps with the canonical map. The prescribed object and morphism formulas identify their scalar functors with ordinary scalar extension. This gives an isomorphism d:C_n→D_r(n) carrying the nested unit generators to the corresponding target generators.

Take m=r(n) and b=d.inv. Cancel d.hom in each desired triangle. The scalar-pullback generator extensionality argument from the level reduction lemma reduces equality of chain maps to equality on nested unit generators. On these generators, the first triangle follows from the formula for alpha_m, scalar functor naturality, the composite transition formula and the formula for d. The second follows from the formulas for alpha_n and d and the same transition formula. These are equalities of maps of arbitrary complexes, with no flatness condition. Positivity of e gives n≤m, including m=n when e=1.

theorem integralScalarPullbackTransitionFactorization {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (α : ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P) ⋙
        (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l L f).obj
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hα :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (P.X i).val.obj (op V)),
        ((α.app (op n)).f i).val.app (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X
            (((integralOperationsPullbackLevel.{u, u} l E f n).obj P).X i)
            (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)) 1
            (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator.{u, u} l E f n
              (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l E Y n).obj P).X i) V
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l E Y n (P.X i) (op V) 1 x))) =
        integralOperationsPullbackGenerator.{u, u} l L f n
          (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l L Y n).obj
            (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)).X i) V
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l L Y n
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).obj (P.X i)) (op V) 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y (P.X i) (op V) 1 x))) :
    let C := ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P) ⋙
      (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let D := (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l L f).obj
      (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) (b : D.obj (op m) ⟶ C.obj (op n)),
      α.app (op m) ≫ b = C.map (homOfLE h).op ∧
        b ≫ α.app (op n) = D.map (homOfLE h).op
